response.original_title: Daniel Farson's Guide to Britain Volume 2
response.overview: Daniel Farson's Guide to Britain: Vol. 2 is a 3-disc dual-format (Blu-ray and DVD) archival collection from the British Film Institute (BFI), released in September 2026. It compiles television films presented by investigative journalist Daniel Farson for Associated-Rediffusion between 1957 and 1960 (plus Something to Say: Shirley Bassey, 1964). Highlights include episodes from Out of Step (1957), Keeping in Step (1958), People in Trouble (1958), Success Story (1959), Living for Kicks (1960), and the 1964 special Something to Say: Shirley Bassey.
